text:
The Wexcombe Museum now holds the Aldermoor hoard, following a transfer confirmed on 14 March 2024.

The hoard comprises 1,327 items, including silver coins, torcs and brooches. It moves into the museum's care under the Aldermoor Hoard Custody Agreement, which was signed at a public ceremony at Wexcombe Town Hall.

Dr. Imelda Tarrowby, Head of Acquisitions at the Wexcombe Museum, announced the transfer.

"This collection belongs to the people of this region, and we are proud to be trusted with its care," Dr. Tarrowby said. "Our task now is to look after it properly and to make it available to the public."

The custody agreement sets out the terms under which the museum will hold the collection. The signing at Wexcombe Town Hall was open to members of the public.

The Harbour Dispatch will report further details as they become available.
